name: EPIC 220195994
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 8, 9.8 solar radii and 0.88 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220195994 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.798498 (16th-84th percentiles 9.364332-10.271235), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220195994: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4887.1626 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 220195994 (K2 campaign 8): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 4205.78125 (16th-84th percentiles 4061.171875-4357.1875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 4,206 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 8, give 0.88 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,887 K at its surface.
